text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the shopping district to 
buy some things on my day off—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—So, that one-piece dress is the newest 
piece from 'Boutique Cherie'?

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yep, this is our masterpiece! Great, isn't 
it? A combo of python and leopard print! 
Plus it's got snake and leopard faces on 
it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well... yeah, it's super flashy. Though 
the color and shape are mature and cute."

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you like it, Nei-chan? If you're 
buying, I'll give you a discount! And 
throw in a tiger-print pochette too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, that combo's too soon for me... I 
mean, nobody can pull that off except Big 
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Nature! With stuff like this, you 
just throw it on! They're just clothes!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Boutique Cherie's Kimie, 
her fashion level is definitely 66...!

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hey, that's my age you're talking 
about! Say any more and I'll force you to 
buy it, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nahaha~, give me a break on that one—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa?! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What're you doing in a place like this... 
wait, there's nothing else to do in a 
shopping district besides shopping.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Right, you're the only youngster who comes 
by just to shoot the breeze because she's 
bored, Nat-chan.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? This shopping street 
is cutting-edge!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at this selection too, 
Trainer! They say it's the best in the 
world when it comes to animal prints!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kimie-san! Why don't you put together 
a special outfit for Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, make it super rugged! 
Something that says 'don't mess with me'!"

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Nei-chan, you're troubling the 
Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Look, aren't they still shopping? 
Nei-chan, go keep them company.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? Yours truly is so tuckered out, she 
can't move another single inch.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying, young people?! Don't 
just hang around in a place like this, go 
on a date or something!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All ri—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, n-no way, that's not it, right!? 
I-It's totally not a date, okay!?

"—Afterward, Nice Nature showed me around 
the shopping street, and I managed to buy 
everything I was looking for."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, we walked so much. My lower back is 
killing me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No need, no need! You don't have to thank 
me. It's not like I did anything big.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say I accompanied you, all I 
did was chat with the folks in the 
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, honestly, all anyone can talk about 
is dates, dates, dates... What a bunch of 
slackers~

Despite her blunt phrasing, Nice Nature 
had a gentle look on her face as she 
talked about the shopping street folks.

I knew she was well-loved by the shopping 
district folks, but they truly are people 
Nice Nature can rely on from the bottom of 
her heart.
choice_data_list: You really love everyone, don't you?
You really love everyone, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I do like it, but...! Why did you 
have to go and say it out loud?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That makes me feel kind of itchy...
choice_data_list:
We're practically family at this point, 
huh.

We're practically family at this point, 
aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if that's how it'll turn out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, sure? She might be even more 
meddlesome than a parent, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides... everyone cheers for me like 
it's the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"*Me*, of all people, you know? It's 
honestly laughable."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost laughable how much they care 
about me..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And when people cheer me on, it kinda 
makes me think, "Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what was I even going on about? 
Ugh, so embarrassing!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three... and done! With this, 
Trainer has forgotten everything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come now, let's head on home~.

Hurried along by an embarrassed Nice 
Nature, the two of us headed back to the 
Academy together that day.
